_comment: Torchbearer 2nd Edition extraction profile. Two-column body, page numbers in the bottom corner. The books ship with a usable PDF outline (chapter/section bookmarks) so the chunker is outline-driven — header/footer scan is the printed-page-number source of truth, not the section boundary source. Front matter is small (cover + credits + ToC) and printed numbering aligns 1:1 with PDF page index from page 4 onwards.
